central_idea_and_construction: Exactly the two Korean syllables 물결 as a quiet custom lettering-only wordmark. Preserve every normal consonant and vowel component: 물 = ㅁ + ㅜ + ㄹ, 결 = ㄱ + ㅕ + ㄹ. Especially keep the downward stem of ㅜ and the two left-facing short strokes of ㅕ. Use broad rounded brush-like strokes with controlled slight variation, subtly rising horizontal strokes, soft but clear corners, generous open internal spaces. The two complete syllable blocks have equal visual weight and a clear inter-syllable gap. A gentle wave is expressed only through the baseline and terminal rhythm, never by replacing a letter. Blue single ink, 64% width centered. No separate wave, underline, landscape or watery gradients.
background_role: plain white negative space; no inset outer tile
material: flat ink / pixel clusters; no material rendering
small_size_signature: Full 물/결 structure and calm horizontal rhythm.
specific_risk: ㄹ terminals and ㅕ strokes can merge if the rhythm is over-stylized.
reference_transfer: Negative user screenshots analyzed as text: avoid severed slabs and nested squared Ls; no positive visual reference or borrowed signature.
observations: Recorded separately after viewing actual output.
